en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large, austere modernist office building with many identical rectangular windows arranged in a grid. The structure stands on a raised stone platform above a wide cobblestone square. A single small figure walks in the open foreground; a few trees and smaller buildings are visible on the sides. Handwritten text in white at the bottom left and right identifies the place.
